findings.current: A thrill ran down my spine.
findings.defect: The English omits the explicit simultaneity of the thrill with spotting the gap.
findings.rationale: 동시에 establishes that the sensation occurs at the moment he notices the passage, not merely afterward.
findings.replacement: At the same time, a thrill ran down my spine.

findings.current: I took a small breath and slipped inside.
findings.defect: “Small breath” reverses or obscures 심호흡, a deep breath, and “slipped inside” drops the deliberate action of pushing his body into the entrance.
findings.rationale: 작게 modifies the quietness of the deep breath, while 몸을 들이밀다 describes deliberately thrusting or pushing his body inside.
findings.replacement: I quietly took a deep breath, then pushed my body inside.

findings.current: A charred piece of wood lay on the waterlogged cave floor, and oil floated on the pooled water.
findings.defect: The English adds “charred” before the object has been identified as a torch and omits the physical detail that the wood was lying overturned or face down.
findings.rationale: The source first presents it only as a fallen piece of wood lying in pooled water; its half-burned state and torch identity are established afterward.
findings.replacement: A piece of wood lay overturned on the cave floor, where water had pooled, and oil floated on its surface.

findings.current: If water dripping from my body had struck the floor and made a sound, the Dongting Fisherman would have discovered me.
findings.defect: “Discovered me” reduces the consequence from having his identity exposed to merely being detected.
findings.rationale: 정체를 들키다 specifically refers to having one’s identity or true nature revealed.
findings.replacement: If water dripping from my body had struck the floor and made a sound, the Dongting Fisherman would have realized who I was.

findings.defect: The sound effect suggests ongoing cracking, rather than the small pieces or section of wall dropping away when touched.
findings.rationale: 투두둑 depicts repeated small impacts or pieces falling, matching the immediately following wall fragment dropping away.

summary: Mostly faithful, with several localized omissions or additions affecting timing, physical detail, and the narrator’s stealth inference.
